    Functorial finiteness of compact torsion classes #

    Condition (comp-tors) of Theorem 3.2 (thm:core) and Theorem A(I): over any field, R is E-finite if and only if every singly generated (compact) torsion class ⊥(M⊥) in mod R is functorially finite (isEFinite_iff_generatedTorsionClass_functoriallyFinite), equivalently if and only if ⊥(B⊥) is functorially finite for every brick B.
